name: Health Summary Rings
description: A monochrome React Native health summary: activity rings that draw in and lap past 100%, figures that count up from a blur, drawn charts and a gliding week picker.

props.name: days
props.description: Seven days with ring values, steps, hourly steps, resting heart rate, sleep stages and bed/wake times. Future days render as empty tracks and can't be picked.

props.name: rings
props.description: Move, Exercise and Stand: label, unit, goal, first-lap gradient and the deeper second-lap gradient. The only multi-hue colour in the component.

props.name: initialDay
props.description: Index of the day selected on mount. Defaults to the last day that isn't in the future.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour outside the rings: the step sparkline's "now" dot and the heartbeat comet. Everything else is greyscale.

props.name: onDayChange
props.description: Fired when the week selector moves.

props.name: onRingSelect
props.description: Fired when a ring is isolated, or cleared.
